description: Implement backend/app/llm.py: a small client wrapper around AWS Bedrock (converse API) with dependency injection so tests run a fake client by default; model id and region from environment-backed settings; structured answer() returning text plus usage/metadata; this unit performs no identity-material handling: the underlying runtime configuration is an integration-stage concern documented in backend/README; optional integration flag documented and default-off.
acceptance_criteria: wrapper returns a structured LLMResult including text, model_id and usage tokens
unit tests pass with a fake/injectable client, zero network
settings read BEDROCK_MODEL_ID/AWS_REGION via environment with safe defaults and no identity material committed in code or repository
integration flag AWS_INTEGRATION=0/1 documented, integration test skipped unless enabled

planning.title: Bedrock LLM client wrapper with fake-client tests
